title: ConnectorsCallData
description:
`connectors.call`'s reply (5.3): `{run_id, decision, content?, is_error?, model_turns}`.
A denied call is an error (`denied`, with `detail.by`), never this reply, so `decision`
is `allow`; `content` is the tool's result exactly as Claude Code gave it, up to 1 MiB,
and `is_error` whether the tool said it failed.

is_error.description: Whether the tool said it failed.

model_turns.description: Always 0: the call is made with no model turn.

Decision.description: What a tool call was decided (5.1).

oneOf.description: It doesn't, and the app saved it as a draft (`draft_id`).
